NEW YORK WORLD-TELEGRAM & SUN
New York, New York
December 6, 1954
Dr. Hockett Joins Tobacco Group
Dr. Robert C. Hockett has been a member of the Council of the Institute of Medicine's director of the ToebaC
Industry Research Canada announced a new announced today by Dr. Clarence Cook, the director of the research center.
Dr. Hockett will aid Dr. Little and the Scientific
Advisory Board in developing the tobacco industry's program of research into tobacco use and health, said. The committee recently issued grants of $82,000 to six institutions for basic research projects and is reviewing applications for additional grants, Dr. Hockett spent nine years prior to the final approval of Sugar Research Foundation.
Dr. R. C. Hockett
NALL STREET JOURNAL
New York, New York
December 7, 1954
NEW YORK TIES
New York, New York
December 6, 1954
Tobacco Research Aide Named
WASHINGTON, Dec. 5 UP! Dr Robert C. Hockett was appointed as the director of the Tobacco Industry Research Commission. David M. McLaughlin, a former MoH assistant assist the committee in research on tobacco industry and its impact on Hockett until recently was a consultant, to Arthur D. Little, to John R. Kornfeld, and to beverage companies. He is a former associate professor of the School of Business atenschufts Institute of Technology.
Tobacco Industry to Back Study
NEW YORK: The tobacco industry's research committee expects to spend about \(60- 000 in the first year on a new project it's launching to study human lung ailments.
The committee plans to give a research grant to a group of pathologists to conduct a study on the risk of developing lung cancers. The data collected will be gathered at a central location for tabulating, comparing and analyzing. The group met here to discuss the results and agreed that it would adopt specific plans at a later meeting.
COR TI 14671
